decisions.statement: Judge-human agreement on money: Krippendorff's alpha = 0.821 [0.712, 0.901], n=64. Above the pre-registered threshold of 0.667; used for headline scoring.
Judge-human agreement on invoice_date: Krippendorff's alpha = 0.744 [0.653, 0.826], n=58. Above the pre-registered threshold of 0.667; used for headline scoring.

Judge-human agreement on free_text_notes: Krippendorff's alpha = 0.512 [0.331, 0.634], n=31. Below the pre-registered threshold of 0.667; this field type is not used for headline scoring and is reported as not measured.

order_effect.statement: Order effect on money: first-shown rate 0.86 vs second-shown rate 0.83, difference 0.03, n=64. No corrective action taken at this sample size.

length_effect.statement: Length effect on money, by response-length quintile (shortest to longest): 0.80, 0.83, 0.86, 0.88, 0.85. No monotonic length bias detected.

note: order_effect/length_effect are not yet emitted by ground_truth.publish.leaderboard._agreement_to_dict (it serializes only field_type, alpha, alpha_ci, status, n_units, statement) -- these two fields are placeholder-only pending that wiring.
